local lb = lc.builder.LayerBuilder()
lb:setName("renderer-fixture")
lb:setLineWidth(lc.meta.MetaLineWidthByValue(1.0))
lb:setColor(lc.Color(255, 0, 0, 255))
local layer = lb:build()
lc.operation.AddLayer.new(document, layer):execute()
local b = lc.builder.LineBuilder()
b:setLayer(layer)
b:setStartPoint(lc.geo.Coordinate(0.0, 0.0))
b:setEndPoint(lc.geo.Coordinate(3.0, 4.0))
local eb = lc.operation.EntityBuilder.new(document)
eb:appendEntity(b:build())
eb:execute()
